In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] led a '''Rebel mission''' of the [[Shiva system/Legends|Shiva system]] to investigate [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activity there. Organa met the [[Calian Confederacy]] leader, [[Aron Peacebringer]], on [[Shiva IV]] and together they were captured by Imperial forces led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]].<ref name="SW53" />
